title: sse: escape-aware chunk skipper and replay-id header for deterministic partial-JSON recovery
author: Priya Banerjee
description: Background: partial JSON emissions from fragmented SSE frames sometimes produced irreproducible outcomes when escape sequences were split across chunks or when clients replayed windows during transient reconnections. Motivation: make stream recovery deterministic and safe for structured output and function/tool calls while preserving OpenAI-compatible framing semantics. What this PR does: adds a lightweight per-stream replay-id header embedded in SSE preamble frames so servers and clients can detect and drop duplicate replay windows; implements an escape-aware chunk skipper in the stream lexer that refuses to split inside a UTF-8 escape or JSON string escape sequence and emits an explicit chunk-boundary marker when a logical JSON token is suspended; changes the reassembly algorithm to prefer deterministic coalescing by comparing replay-id+offset tuples and to prefer the longest valid JSON prefix rather than first-come fragments; adds a small handshake to the OpenAI-compat layer to surface replay-id in text/event-stream responses and documents the compatibility behavior. Why this matters: reduces flakiness for structured output, avoids duplicate function-call boundaries after reconnects, and improves signal for client-side dedupe without changing the visible SSE semantics for existing clients. Backwards compatibility: clients that ignore the replay-id header will continue to work; the chunk-boundary marker is a no-op for parsers that do not inspect it. Testing: unit tests for edge-case escapes, fuzzed integration test that simulates mid-UTF8-split and network replay, interop test with openai-compat shim, and e2e test that validates deterministic toolcall ordering under reconnect. Checklist: - Add replay-id header and generation path - Implement escape-aware chunk skipper and marker emission - Update reassembly logic to use replay-id windows - Add unit, integration, and e2e tests - Update docs/openai_sse_compat.md and changelog - Run perf suite to validate negligible latency overhead Rollout plan: land behind a feature flag and enable rollout to 10% of traffic for one week while monitoring structured-output regression alerts and replay-id collision metrics. Related: ENG-3127 ticket for structured-output flakiness and SUP-4412 customer incident where function-call repeated during reconnect.

release_notes: Fixes: deterministic recovery for partial JSON frames in SSE by adding replay-id header and escape-aware chunk boundaries; reduces duplicate tool/function-call emissions on reconnects. Backwards compatible behind feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag stream.replay_detection=false by default. Gradually roll to true for 10% of sessions; monitor metric stream.replayid.collisions and structured-output.regressions. If collisions exceed 0.1% disable and open ENG-3201.
